description: 경기도_생태하천 복원사업 현황 [dams, reservoirs and flood defences] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 경기도. 이 데이터는 경기도에서 추진한 생태하천 복원사업의 현황을 정리한 자료로, 복원이 진행된 하천의 이름, 하천이 포함된 시군명, 사업 길이(km), 사업 시작 및 종료 지점에 대한 정보를. Coverage: 경기도. The portal files it under the publisher 경기도. Its tags are 물정보시스템, 생태하천, 복원사업, 하천복원, 도시하천. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2025-11-27 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support flood defence and reservoir studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
